1-313FP: Evac+Chair Metal Storage Cabinet for Evacuation Chairs
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/evac-chair-metal-storage-cabinet
Manufacturer page: https://evac-chair.com/accessories/secure-storage-cabinet/
Spec sheet: Storage Cabinet data sheet
Keywords (Ricky's sheet): Primary: evacuation chair storage (0-10/mo). Secondary: evacuation chair cabinet (0, not indexed), evacuation chair wall mount (0). Ricky's note: no search demand; write for the product: aluminum self-assembly storage cabinet for an evacuation chair.
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Evac+Chair Flat-Pack Metal Storage Cabinet for Evacuation Chairs – 1-313FP
Current H1: Evac+Chair 1-313FP Metal Storage Cabinet
Subtitle: Aluminum Evacuation Chair Storage Cabinet with a Wide Door and Non-Locking Paddle Handle for Quick Access, for Wall or Floor Mounting
Current subtitle: Evac+Chair 1-313FP Metal Storage Cabinet
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Evac+Chair Metal Storage Cabinet is an aluminum evacuation chair storage cabinet. It keeps an evacuation chair clean, protected, and easy to find, and its wide door with a non-locking paddle handle lets staff open it and take the chair out quickly in an emergency.
The cabinet ships flat packed with 5 panels and fixing bolts, and two people can assemble it in about 20 minutes. It can stand on the floor or be fixed to a wall through pre-drilled holes in the back. This yellow evacuation chair cabinet carries the Evac+Chair logo on the door, so it is easy to spot in a stairwell or corridor.
Material: Aluminum, single wall design
Door: Wide manual door with a non-locking paddle handle, for easy access and quick removal of the chair
Visibility: Yellow cabinet with a highly visible Evac+Chair logo on the door
Mounting: Wall or floor mounted; pre-drilled holes in the back of the cabinet for easy wall mounting
Assembly: Ships flat packed with 5 panels and fixing bolts; assembles in about 20 minutes (2 people recommended)
Size: 30⅜”W×16½”D×50¼”H
Weight: 57 lbs
Use: Commercial storage cabinet
Available Models and Options
1-313FP – Metal Storage Cabinet: Flat-pack aluminum cabinet, yellow, 30⅜”W×16½”D×50¼”H
Optional Locking Handle: Available on request
[H2] Where to Use an Evacuation Chair Cabinet
The cabinet suits any building that keeps an evacuation chair ready near a stairwell, where the chair should be protected but quick to reach.
Typical applications include:
Stairwell landings and corridors in offices, hotels, and high-rise buildings
Schools, universities, and public buildings
Hospitals, clinics, senior living, and care facilities
Explore Anchortex's Evacuation Chairs and Stretchers collection for more evacuation equipment.
[H2] Frequently Asked Questions
Why keep an evacuation chair in a cabinet?
Evacuation chair storage in a cabinet keeps the chair clean and protected while it is not in use, and the yellow cabinet and Evac+Chair logo show staff and visitors where the chair is. The non-locking paddle handle means nobody needs a key to get the chair out in an emergency.
Can the cabinet be wall mounted?
Yes. It can be wall or floor mounted, and pre-drilled holes in the back make it easy to fix to a wall. It is an alternative to a bare evacuation chair wall mount, where the chair hangs on an open bracket.
How big is the cabinet, and does it come assembled?
Assembled, it measures 30⅜” wide, 16½” deep, and 50¼” high, and it weighs 57 lbs. It ships flat packed to keep shipping cost and damage down, and two people can assemble it in about 20 minutes.
[H2] About Evac+Chair Evacuation Chairs
Evac+Chair makes stair evacuation chairs, powered stair chairs, evacuation sleds, and accessories for moving people with limited mobility on stairs, in an emergency or every day.
The Evac+Chair line includes:
Emergency evacuation chairs: The 300H, 400H, 600H, and 750H stair evacuation chairs for controlled travel down the stairs
Powered stair climbing chairs: The battery powered Power 800 and Power 900 for going up and down the stairs
Stair transport seat: The IBEX 700H Tran-Seat for two-person transport up and down the stairs
Evacuation sleds and mats: The Evac+Sled, Ulti-Mat, and Evac+Sheet rescue sheet
Accessories: Comfy Seat, transfer seat, storage cabinets, anti-theft alarms, and the iEvac smoke and fire escape hood
[H2] About Evac+Chair
Evac+Chair has made stairway evacuation chairs since 1982, and its chairs were designed in the United States. Explore the full line of Evac+Chair evacuation chairs at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Keywords: as Ricky noted, these terms have no search demand, so the copy is written for the product. The primary keyword "evacuation chair storage" is in the subtitle, first sentence, an FAQ answer, the meta title, and the meta description. "Evacuation chair cabinet" is in the second intro paragraph and a subhead, and "evacuation chair wall mount" is in an FAQ answer.
Material: the Evac+Chair web page and data sheet say aluminum, and so does our current page. The Evac+Chair range brochure lists a "Secure Steel Cabinet" (20 gauge galvanized steel), and our image file is named "Stainless Steel Cabinet." I used aluminum, from the data sheet. Is the 1-313FP the aluminum flat-pack cabinet?
Name: Evac+Chair calls it the "Storage Cabinet," "Flatpack Metal Storage Cabinet," and "Secure Storage Cabinet." I kept our name, Metal Storage Cabinet, and added "Flat-Pack" to the H1.
Fit: Evac+Chair does not say which chairs fit in the cabinet, so I gave the cabinet size in an FAQ and did not list models. Do you know which models fit?
Locking handle: our page says "Optional locking handle available upon request," and the brochure lists it for the steel cabinet. It is not on the current Evac+Chair page or data sheet. I kept it as an option. Is it still available?
Specs: size (50¼” x 30⅜” x 16½”), weight (57 lbs), and color (yellow) are from the data sheet. The variant weight is 200 lbs. Is that a placeholder?
Returns: the data sheet says "All cabinets are non-refundable and non-returnable once delivered." I did not add this to the description. Would you like it on the page?
Duplicate content: our current description is the Evac+Chair text word for word, plus an old "About Evac+Chair of North America" paragraph ending "Ask about their lifetime warranty." Evac+Chair gives no warranty for the cabinet, so I left the warranty out. The new copy is fully rewritten.
Images: the one current image (1214×783) is the same yellow cabinet as on the Evac+Chair page. Evac+Chair has 2 more photos at 1214×783: a front view and an assembly diagram. Would you like me to add them as "Evac-Chair-Metal-Storage-Cabinet-1-313FP-Front-View.jpg" and "Evac-Chair-Metal-Storage-Cabinet-1-313FP-Assembly-Diagram.jpg"?
Price: $1,050 with compare-at $1,400 (75%). No change made.
Current meta description is the general GSA pricing line. GSA is not mentioned in the description, per your note on the other tabs.
